item.name: Crime data
item.description: Approximate, anonymised street-level crime data from Police.uk. Coverage is England, Wales and Northern Ireland; Scotland includes British Transport Police data only.

query.description: A UK postcode. It is normalised and resolved to coordinates before the Police.uk request. Must not be greater than 16 characters.
A non-future month in YYYY-MM format. Omit it to use the latest provider data. Must be a valid date in the format Y-m.

request.description: Returns approximate street-level crime records near a postcode.

item.name: VAT
item.description: Deterministic VAT calculations for GBP amounts. Calculations are provided for convenience and are not tax advice.

query.description: Amount in GBP, with up to two decimal places. Use the net amount for calculate and the gross amount for remove. Must match the regex /^(?:0|[1-9]\d{0,11})(?:\.\d{1,2})?$/.
VAT rate as a percentage, from 0 to 100, with up to two decimal places. Must match the regex /^(?:0|[1-9]\d{0,2})(?:\.\d{1,2})?$/. Must be between 0 and 100.

request.description: Calculates the VAT to add to a net GBP amount.

response.name: VAT calculation
Missing, invalid or revoked API key
